page.layout: One page of text: centred dedication title block at the top, then one body column with a woodcut initial. No margin notes. Page number at the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: SINGVLARI VIRO, PAVLO FLORENIO, SACRÆ THEOLOGIÆ DOCTORI, atqj omnium humanarum præstantia scientiarum ornatissimo, Christianus Francken
main_text.p: Q[?]oniam semper ad te, Paule doctissime, mens mea recurrit, singularis, & divini memor sermonis, quem paucis diebus ante tuum ex Iesuitarum religione discessum mecum habuisti: necessarium esse plane iudicavi, cum mihi ipsi, ad nostra recordationem amicitiæ declarandam: tum maxime omnibus Christianis, ad salutis suæ dulcissimum, Iesuque divino nomine tectum & occultatum venenum cognoscendum, ut sermo hic quoq; tuus, vel nostr[?] potius, litterarum mandatus monimentis, ad te in primis, tanquam ad præcipuum auctorem suum, recognoscendi gratia, præsentemq; te, cum ipse iam venire non possim, amandi, reverteretur: deinde vero monendi causa ad omnes, qui ubiq; sunt, Christianos exire permitteretur. Etenim tata huius, tamq; aper-

page.notes: The woodcut initial is decorative, so its letter is uncertain: read as Q[?] (the word is probably "Quoniam"). "tata" and "nostr[?]" are read as printed and may be printing errors. The running text ends with "aper-" and continues on the next page with the catchword "ta" below the text. The title block is set in large capitals and spaced type; "S. P. D." is a greeting, so it is a paragraph.
